---
title: "Brain Summary"
author: "Raymond Hackworthy"
---
I want to calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain, which is the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in the human, pig and mouse.
```{r}
x <- sum(180,83,57,110)
print(paste("The total number of these genes in humans is",x,"."))
y <- sum(109,157,31,45)
print(paste("The total number of these genes in pigs is",y,"."))
z <- sum(55,185,60,98)
print(paste("The total number of these genes in mice is",z,"."))
```

In conclusion, humans have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain.
